summary: Accept fractal as an authored MCP server name alongside st3.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: Claude MCP config readers and eval stubs accept fractal as well as st3. Present st3 entries always win, even when malformed. Existing server entries remain verbatim; a fractal entry is not duplicated as st3. The development-channel selector follows the selected server name. Newly inserted servers and serverInfo writers still use st3.

manual.detail: No config migration required; legacy configurations remain supported.

recovery.detail: No stored data migration to undo. Legacy writers remain unchanged.
